text:
parse_yaml() {
  local prefix=$2
  local s='[[:space:]]*'
  local w='[a-zA-Z0-9_]*'
  local fs=$(echo @|tr @ '\034')
  sed -ne "s|^$s\($w\)$s:$s[\"']\(.*\)[\"']$s\$|\1$fs\2|p" "$1" |
  while IFS="$fs" read -r key val; do
    echo "${prefix}${key}=\"${val}\""
  done
}

text:
retry_command() {
  local -r max_attempts="$1"
  local -r delay="$2"
  shift 2
  local attempt=1
  until "$@"; do
    if (( attempt >= max_attempts )); then
      echo "Command failed after $attempt attempts." >&2
      return 1
    fi
    echo "Attempt $attempt failed! Retrying in ${delay}s..."
    sleep "$delay"
    ((attempt++))
  done
}
